leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useState hook to create and manage a boolean state variable for online status
Use the useEffect hook to set up event listeners for online/offline events
Implement event handler functions to update state when network status changes
Execute conditional cleanup logic to remove event listeners when the component unmounts
Construct a custom hook function with proper TypeScript return type annotations
Utilize the window.navigator.onLine property to initialize the online status state
Assign appropriate event types ('online' and 'offline') to addEventListener and removeEventListener calls
Control component side effects by specifying an empty dependency array in useEffect
Return the current online status value from the custom hook for consumption by components
Define a reusable custom hook that encapsulates the network status monitoring logic
Invoke the custom useOnlineStatus hook within React components to access real-time network status
Modify component rendering behavior based on the boolean value returned by useOnlineStatus
